newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils mixed in quiet pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils mixed in quiet pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Midday European vegetable oil prices on Thursday were mixed in quiet pre-holiday trading.
Traders said activity is expected to be limited to book squaring for the rest of the day ahead of the Good Friday and Easter Monday closure.
Crude palm oil cif Europe was offered $2.50 down to unchanged after May/Jul traded at $545 and $547.50 and Oct/Dec at $545 a tonne cif.
March traded at $552.50 a tonne in a switch with Oct/Dec at $555 a tonne.
RBD palm oil offers were $2.50 up after Apr traded at $538.50, May at $532.50 and Jul at $527.50 a tonne.
Olein was $5 up to unchanged after Apr 1/7 traded at $577.50 and $580 and Apr at $575 and $577.50 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Coconut and palmkernel oil offers were $2.50 down to $5 up in so far tradeless markets.
Among soft oils soy oil was 0.50 guilders down to 0.50 guilders up.
Rape oil sellers were 0.50 to 0.75 guilders lower.
